scientific_integrity: Counts follow from a unique shortest-border partition; infinite asymptotics and the natural boundary follow from explicit meromorphic poles. Standard-library finite tests are corroborative, not proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact one-atom cylinder statistic in the binary golden-mean one-sided shift, uniform admissible words. Not the complete penetration-time distribution, nor arbitrary SFT or Gibbs-weight results. Historical priority is evidence-limited; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: Golden-mean periodic cylinders: a Mahler law and a sharp parity split
